ORFEUS Community-Project Support Grants
=======================================

ORFEUS established the Community-Project Support Fund in 2024.
Grants may be awarded to support the organisation of community events and networking activities
instrumental to the establishment of initiatives/projects relevant for the ORFEUS and European observational
seismology communities.

Call 2025/26: https://polybox.ethz.ch/index.php/s/XJdJvLC0ycM5YEj

* **Uni CAU-Kiel** - "*AdriaArray annual meeting 2025*"
* **UCL** - "*AtlanticArray vision workshop 2025*" 

Call 2026/27: https://polybox.ethz.ch/index.php/s/mSGoMH4DakdHWsi

* **HUN-REN** - "*AdriaArray annual meeting 2026*"
* **IG-CAS** - "*International Workshop on Seismic Anisotropy, Heterogeneity and Dynamics of the Lithosphere-Asthenosphere System - ADLAS 2026*"
